questions.prompt: Which of these are planets in our solar system?
questions.fact: Europa and Titan are moons, and Ceres is a dwarf planet in the asteroid belt.

questions.prompt: Which of these instruments do you play with a bow?
questions.fact: A harp is plucked, not bowed, even though it is a string instrument like the other three.

questions.prompt: How many bones are there in an adult human body?
questions.fact: Babies start with about 300. Some fuse together as you grow, which is how you end up with 206.

questions.prompt: How tall is the Eiffel Tower, in metres?
questions.fact: 330 metres to the tip. It was the tallest building in the world for 41 years.

questions.hint: It is the only one of the four that is not played with a ball.
questions.fact: A shuttlecock can leave the racket at over 400 km/h, the fastest of any racket sport.

questions.prompt: Which spice is the most expensive in the world by weight?
questions.hint: It is picked by hand from the middle of a flower.
questions.fact: Saffron is the dried threads of a crocus flower, and it takes about 150 flowers to make a single gram.
